body:
Founder real-time: 'do we have artifacts publishing and auto releasing the same way as parena repo?' -> 'yea.' New release job in .github/workflows/ci.yml, gated to push-to-main only, reuses PARENA's own release-job pattern verbatim: auto-bumps v{major}.{minor+1}.0 off the latest tag, packages dist/emilyos + EMILYOS_CONSTRUCT.txt into emilyos-linux-amd64.tar.gz, publishes a real regular GitHub Release via gh release create --generate-notes. Single-platform (Linux amd64) unlike PARENA's three-platform bundles, matching this repo's own Linux-only scope. Found and fixed a real packaging bug before it ran: naive same-named download directory would have produced a confusing dist/dist/ nesting from upload-artifact@v4's own LCA-preserving behavior -- fixed via a distinctly-named download dir + flat staging. YAML syntax validated locally; the actual GitHub Actions run itself could not be watched from this sandbox (no gh auth) -- real verification is the founder checking the repo's Releases page after this push. Commit 2f20881.

⚓ ☃
title: CI: add auto-release job matching PARENA's own pattern
